audience_question: Which shuttle option meets the minimum range at the lowest upfront cost?
fit_rationale: Every shuttle is compared on the same three criteria and units; the range threshold and qualifying options make it clear that Alder is the lowest-cost option among those meeting the minimum.
tradeoff: The matrix preserves the annual energy-cost comparison but keeps the answer centered on upfront cost and range; Alder is not presented as best on every criterion.
caveats: Annual energy estimates assume 18,000 kilometres of service per vehicle and exclude maintenance and charging-infrastructure costs.
All figures are estimates from the same procurement worksheet; no uncertainty ranges were provided.
